summary: Legion page re-read: C$33 + GST a night (seniors/veterans C$30), weekly/monthly rates, 56 sites, no power, online-only booking, May long weekend-Sep 30 - all confirmed and made manual; veterans' rate recorded as a military discount. Google 3.9 from 92 = drop candidate; lakefront looks overstated (lakeview recommended).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (Google rating rule): Google Maps 'Sunset Legion Campground' 3.9 from 92 reviews (phone 403-748-2200), under 4.0 with 25+ reviews; the entry has no --AWH note. Other ratings: RV Life 4.5 $ (stored), Campspot 4.8-4.9 from 15. Long-stay character is weak: the page offers weekly and monthly rates but says '*Note - currently there are no seasonal sites available' and sells every night online, so this is not the 'under 4 stars plus borderline seasonal' automatic drop - a reviewer call on the rating alone.

PRICE GATE (private, Legion non-profit): C$33 + GST a night (plus C$5.50 Campspot booking fee per stay) - under C$69. No gateway within 40 km (Edmonton 117 km). Campspot 2027 dates return nothing yet ('Bookings open again on January 1st').

WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - recommend lakeview): on Esri imagery the 56 sites sit in treed loops on the Gull Lake peninsula about 90-110 m from the beach, with trees, shrub and the day-use grass between. The stored evidence cites 'RV units on open sand/gravel shore apron beside the lower boat-launch pier, within ~30m'; the imagery shows two tarped units near the north pier about 30-37 m from the water across a shrubby/treed bank, and nothing on the page says they are public RV sites rather than group/caretaker or overflow (the page names sites 116, 92 and 94 as overflow). Nothing I read shows clearly waterfront public RV sites; recommend downgrading lakefront -> lakeview.

OWNERSHIP: 'Operated by the Lacombe Legion -Branch #79' (Campspot: 'Alberta Non-Profit Corporation'); the 1984 opening text says it was built with the County of Lacombe and a provincial grant, but the page does not say the land is municipal. Private stays.
